written: Each day, at an hour chosen by chance: listen to 365 moments of the world's radio. Keep what has something in it, or, one day in seven, keep everything. Throw the dice to choose which sounds belong together and which patterns of data to fuse them with. Make between five and twelve songs. Title them with words cut from what was heard. Draw the album as a record, one groove spiralling in. Release it at midnight. Delete it the next day. Each day, with a chance of 1 in 365, stop forever.
